mcq_fix.why: Vijayanagara did keep lands south of the Krishna, so old option 1 was actually a peace term

mcq_drop.why: disputed: Berar, Bijapur and Ahmadnagar broke away c. 1484-90; 'first' varies by source

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Vizianagaram zamindari (Pusapati Vijayarama Gajapati), not Odisha Gajapatis

patterns: PSCs ask Bahmani basics: founded 1347 by Hasan Gangu (Zafar Khan), capital Gulbarga, shifted to Bidar by Ahmad Shah I.
APPSC asks Gajapati administrative terms: southern revenue officers = Naidu (GS 2025), with Khandadhipati/Bisayi/Pradhan as distractors.
Watch the 'Gajapati' name trap: Vizianagaram's Vijayarama Gajapati (zamindari) vs the Odisha Gajapati dynasty.
App goes into detailed campaign chronology (Firoz Shah's battles, Kondaveedu 1450, Hamvira) well beyond PYQ depth but sound.
